items.title: Nicci just lost her husband, now she fears she'll lose her support
items.description: NDIS recipient Nicci Carlson, who is in constant pain and may soon lose her eyesight, says cuts to the scheme are making vulnerable people living with a disability scapegoats for Australians hit hard by cost-of-living pressures.

items.title: 'Get this right': Top US Jewish leader's stark warning for Australia
items.description: The leader of one of the world's most high-profile Jewish organisations says Australia faces a crucial test on how it tackles the rise of antisemitism.

items.title: Breastmilk research could protect against deadly respiratory infections in babies
items.description: The international group of researchers found a breastmilk protein, osteopontin, triggers a cascade of biological processes that kickstart immune system development in early life.

items.title: Ukraine drone strike on Russian holiday spot kills 11
items.description: At least 11 people have died and dozens are wounded after Ukraine launched strikes at a Russian Black Sea resort and the annexed peninsula of Crimea.

items.title: Australians warned prediction markets could cost them, with little protection
items.description: As Australians engage with billion-dollar prediction markets, betting on anything from war, weather to pop culture, the corporate watchdog is forced to step in.

items.title: Indonesians mock Trump-style 'personality politics'

items.title: On farms around the country, 21st-century slaves are picking Australia's food

items.title: Older people open to downsizing but facing barriers
items.description: Research shows more than half of people over the age of 55 are open to downsizing. But experts say there are barriers stopping older people moving into smaller homes.

items.title: School founder said 5-year-old behaved 'suggestively', parent claims
